title: Tickeron Launches New AI Trading Robots for Hedge Funds (CRWV, NBIS, BTDR, ASST, IREN, JOBY, LUNR)
author: tickeron_community
selftext:
**New AI-driven trading agents target infrastructure, technology and counter-trend strategies with systematic analysis**

https://preview.redd.it/ul0tlnpi6huh1.png?width=1285&format=png&auto=webp&s=c665112120223e8f0d27b8be41cd0b9528ab8a70

AI infrastructure, semiconductor and technology-related stocks continue to attract attention from traders using systematic approaches to market analysis. [Tickeron](https://tickeron.com/) is expanding its portfolio of AI Trading Robots and AI Trading Agents covering stocks including CoreWeave (CRWV), Nebius (NBIS), Bitdeer Technologies (BTDR), Asset Entities (ASST), IREN, Joby Aviation (JOBY) and Intuitive Machines (LUNR).  
  
The new robots apply algorithmic approaches to defined groups of securities and provide trading results over periods of approximately one year. For example, Tickeron's AI Infrastructure agent covering CRWV and NBIS reports a realized return of +193% over 363 days, while the BTDR AI Trading Agent reports +192% over 364 days. These figures represent historical results and are not forecasts of future performance.  
  
**Summary**  
  
Tickeron has launched a new group of [AI Trading Robots](https://tickeron.com/app/ai-robots/trending-robots/) and AI Trading Agents designed to apply systematic, AI-driven analysis to selected market themes and individual securities.

* CRWV/NBIS AI Trading Agent: +193% realized return over 363 days.
* BTDR AI Trading Agent: +192% over 364 days.
* ASST AI Trading Agent: +137% over 364 days.
* IREN/JOBY/LUNR Counter-Trend AI Trading Agent: +107% over 364 days.
* Semi & Technology and semiconductor-focused agents also cover multiple technology-related securities.

  
The published results include additional systems covering AEM, CLSK, NEM, COHR/GLW, MRVL/TECL, NVDA/USAR, MU/AMD and TSM/AMKR. Tickeron provides individual performance details through its [AI Trading Robot platform](https://tickeron.com/bot-trading/?via=serhii-bondarenko).  
  
Tickeron's approach combines algorithmic trading with Financial Learning Models (FLMs), which are designed to process financial information and support AI-driven market analysis. The company has recently expanded its computing infrastructure and increased the capabilities of its FLMs to support more sophisticated AI analysis and trading automation.  
  
Tickeron also offers access to [AI Trading Robots](https://tickeron.com/bot-trading/?via=serhii-bondarenko) and related analytical tools. Current subscription offers include Daily Buy/Sell Signals — $5/month (50% OFF), AI Trading Robots — $45/month (50% OFF), and AI Robots Unlimited — $125/month (50% OFF).  
  
Tickeron is also developing AI-assisted financial research through its Financial Learning Models and Ask AI capabilities.  
  
"Ask AI represents a major milestone in the evolution of our Financial Learning Models. We're transforming hours of financial research into a single click, giving investors instant answers powered by AI," said Sergey Savastiouk, Ph.D., CEO and Founder of Tickeron.  
  
Additional performance details and system descriptions are available through Tickeron's trading results (https://tickeron.com/bot-trading/5968-AI-Infrastructure-CRWV-NBIS-Trading-Results-AI-Trading-Agent-60min/?via=serhii-bondarenko) and Counter-Trend [AI Trading Agent](https://tickeron.com/app/ai-robots/trending-robots/)

comments.author: leroylabs
comments.body: The key missing denominator is how these robots were selected. Was the CRWV/NBIS agent, with its reported +193% over 363 days, specified before that period, or chosen afterward from many ticker combinations and FLM variants? Publishing every candidate tested, the 60-minute execution assumptions, fees and slippage, and a same-period CRWV/NBIS buy-and-hold benchmark would make the result falsifiable. The screenshot is unavailable here, so I would also check whether its equity curve marks open positions and maximum drawdown.
